title: Alternative Data Anomaly Detection & Geopolitical Trading System

overview.description: An end-to-end autonomous trading system that ingests free alternative data sources (satellite imagery, aircraft tracking, seismic data, financial indicators) to detect geopolitical and real-world anomalies before prediction markets price them in. The system combines three intelligence layers: (1) a multi-source anomaly detection engine using NASA FIRMS thermal data as the primary signal with 9 confirming sources, (2) a wallet intelligence pipeline that parses 17K+ Polymarket wallets to extract copytrade signals and strategy patterns, and (3) a Claude-based decision engine that synthesizes anomaly signals, wallet intelligence, and market data into trade decisions with dynamic Kelly sizing. The system targets 1-21 day lead time on geopolitical events, with proven backtest results showing detection of Oct 7 (11x anomaly), Kursk offensive (4 days early), and Assad's fall (3 weeks early).
objectives: Detect geopolitical and real-world anomalies 1-21 days before prediction markets price them in, using free satellite and alternative data sources
Maintain a 10-source alternative data pipeline costing $0/month for data acquisition, with NASA FIRMS as the primary anomaly signal
Implement multi-source confirmation scoring that requires 2+ independent data sources before generating a trade signal to reduce false positives
Parse and classify 17,000+ Polymarket wallets to identify high-performing strategies, detect insider-like positioning patterns, and generate copytrade signals
Build a Claude-powered decision engine that cross-references all data sources, estimates true probabilities, calculates edge vs market price, and outputs structured trade decisions
Apply dynamic Kelly Criterion position sizing scaled by anomaly severity (magnitude multiplier), confirming source count, and wallet intelligence confidence
Achieve positive expected value across geopolitical prediction market trades with a target 65-75% directional accuracy on anomaly-triggered signals
Execute trades autonomously on Polymarket via py-clob-client with configurable risk limits, take-profit, stop-loss, and time-stop rules
Record complete market data (order books, fills, spreads) to enable statistically valid backtesting with minimum 1000 windows per strategy
constraints: All data sources must be free (no Bloomberg Terminal, no Planet Labs, no enterprise-tier subscriptions)

NASA FIRMS NRT data has ~3 hour processing delay from satellite observation to API availability. URT (Ultra Real-Time) data is available within 60 seconds via FIRMS URT endpoints — evaluate URT for maximum detection speed. This is swing trading, not HFT
Polymarket geopolitical markets typically have $10K-$100K total volume; position sizes must be capped at 2% of market volume to avoid slippage
Claude API is not classified intelligence — expect ~70% directional accuracy, which Kelly sizing must absorb
Anomaly detection only works for FIRST spikes; continuation signals after baseline tripling must be filtered out
Backtest results use estimated entry/exit prices since Polymarket does not expose full historical price data — treat P&L as directional, not audited
Sample size is inherently small for geopolitical events (7 major events over 16 months, 22 signals); system must be treated as a proof of concept with real data
Security: never use main wallet, audit all dependencies, cap USDC approvals, start with minimal funds ($50-100)
Must handle rate limits on all free APIs without data gaps

System must operate on a 15-minute polling cycle via Task Scheduler (Windows) or cron (Linux/Mac), with full pipeline executing in under 90-120 seconds (10 async API calls + anomaly detection + Claude API at 2-10s latency + order placement makes 60 seconds unrealistic)
assumptions: NASA FIRMS API will remain free and accessible with a MAP_KEY registration at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov

OpenSky Network (free registered account), USGS, CoinGecko (free Demo API key), ExchangeRate API (free API key), Alternative.me, and other free APIs will maintain their current free-tier access policies
Polymarket will continue operating with on-chain settlement via Polygon USDC and py-clob-client API access
Claude API (Anthropic) will remain available for probabilistic analysis at current pricing (~$0.015/query for wallet analysis, higher for trade decisions)
Thermal anomaly patterns from satellite data correlate with geopolitical escalation events with sufficient lead time to generate tradeable signals
Prediction markets are inefficient enough in pricing geopolitical events that a ~3 hour NRT data delay (or ~60s URT delay) still provides actionable edge
Wallet behavior patterns on Polymarket are stable enough that historical analysis predicts future positioning
The 87% of wallets that lose money create sufficient counter-party liquidity for the system to enter positions

components.name: DataIngestionLayer
components.description: Centralized data collection service that polls all 10 alternative data sources on a 15-minute cycle and normalizes responses into a unified internal format. Handles API key management (NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY), rate limiting, retry logic, and data persistence to local storage for backtesting.

subcomponents.name: FIRMSCollector
subcomponents.description: Polls NASA FIRMS VIIRS API for thermal anomaly data across 6+ monitored geopolitical regions. Returns fire count, coordinates, fire radiative power (FRP) in megawatts, and timestamps. Endpoint: firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/area/csv/{MAP_KEY}/VIIRS_SNPP_NRT/{bbox}/{days}. Requires MAP_KEY from NASA Earthdata registration.

subcomponents.name: OpenSkyCollector
subcomponents.description: Queries OpenSky Network REST API for live aircraft positions within monitored region bounding boxes. Tracks military transport (C-17, C-130, Il-76) patterns, altitude anomalies, and traffic density spikes. Registered account required: anonymous access gives only 400 credits/day, insufficient for 6-region 15-minute polling (~576 requests/day). Free registered account provides 4,000 credits/day.
subcomponents.auth: required: OpenSky account registration (free, provides 4,000 credits/day vs 400 anonymous)

subcomponents.name: USGSCollector
subcomponents.description: Fetches recent M4+ earthquake data from USGS GeoJSON feed. Detects non-natural seismic events (underground tests, large explosions) by cross-referencing location with known geological fault lines. No authentication required.

subcomponents.name: FinancialIndicatorCollector
subcomponents.description: Aggregates financial stress indicators from multiple free APIs: Exchange rates (RUB, IRR, TRY, CNY vs USD) from ExchangeRate API (free API key required, daily refresh), VIX from yfinance (unofficial scraper, use Alpha Vantage or CBOE as primary; VIX only updates during US market hours), gold price from Gold API, BTC/ETH from CoinGecko (free Demo API key recommended), and crypto fear/greed index from Alternative.me.

output_schema.currency_moves: {RUB: float, IRR: float, TRY: float, CNY: float}

subcomponents.name: PolymarketCollector
subcomponents.description: Fetches active geopolitical prediction market contracts from Polymarket Gamma API. Returns contract details, current prices, volume, and liquidity depth. Used as the target market for trade signals.
subcomponents.auth: API key for trading (read is public)

components.name: AnomalyDetectionEngine
components.description: Processes raw data from the ingestion layer through statistical anomaly detection. Uses a 14-day rolling average baseline per region per data source. Flags anomalies when current values exceed configurable threshold multipliers (default 3x for FIRMS). Implements continuation bias filter to skip signals where the baseline itself has tripled in the last 7 days.

secondary_thresholds.usgs_non_natural: any M4+ event flagged as non-natural in monitored region

algorithm.continuation_filter: If 7-day baseline has tripled vs prior 7-day baseline, suppress signals for that region to avoid betting on the 'new normal'

components.name: ConfirmationScorer
components.description: Takes raw anomaly detections and computes a composite tension/confirmation score (0-100) by weighting each confirming data source. Higher scores indicate multi-source convergence and higher-confidence signals. Only anomalies with confirmation_count >= 2 are passed to the decision engine.

weights._note_weather_extreme: Requires a WeatherCollector subcomponent not yet defined. Add a WeatherCollector using OpenMeteo API (free, no key, https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast) or NOAA Climate Data API (free, requires token). If not implemented, remove weather_extreme weight and redistribute 5 points across other sources.

scoring_model.formula: tension_score = sum(weight_i * (1 if source_i triggered else 0)) normalized to 0-100

components.name: WalletIntelligencePipeline
components.description: Bulk wallet analysis engine that parses 17K+ Polymarket wallets using Claude API to classify strategies, detect insider-like positioning, and generate copytrade signals. Runs as a scheduled batch job (daily) with incremental updates. Uses poly_data for historical trade data and polyterm for whale tracking.

subcomponents.name: WalletScraper
subcomponents.description: Ingests wallet data from poly_data (86M+ historical trades) and Polymarket on-chain data. Extracts per-wallet metrics: total PnL, win rate, trade count, average position size, market category distribution, timing patterns.

subcomponents.name: StrategyClassifier
subcomponents.description: Claude-based classifier that maps each wallet to one of 11+ strategy archetypes: barbell/tail risk (Taleb), latency arbitrage (Simons), information edge (Soros), weather lag, market making, momentum, mean reversion, event-driven, copytrade cascade, ML-based, and hybrid. Uses pattern matching on trade timing, size distribution, market selection, and win rate by category.

subcomponents.name: InsiderDetector
subcomponents.description: Flags wallets exhibiting insider-like patterns: fresh addresses with no history entering large positions in low-volume markets, entries within hours of unannounced events, 90%+ win rates on specific-date markets, cluster analysis of coordinated wallet funding (a la Bubblemaps). Integrates with pselamy/polymarket-insider-tracker.
detection_signals: Fresh wallet + large position in dead market
Entry in specific-date market hours before event
Cluster of wallets funded within 24 hours betting same direction
Position size disproportionate to wallet history

subcomponents.name: CopytradeSignalGenerator
subcomponents.description: Monitors flagged high-performer wallets in real-time. When a tracked wallet opens a new position, generates a copytrade signal with the wallet's strategy type, historical accuracy in that market category, position direction, and suggested fraction sizing. Filters: only copy from wallets with Sharpe > 2.0 and category-specific win rate > 60%.

filters._note_sharpe: Sharpe > 2.0 is easily inflated by low-variance near-certainty bets common in binary markets. Supplement with profit factor (gross wins / gross losses) as a secondary filter to avoid copying wallets that only bet on near-resolved markets.

components.name: ClaudeDecisionEngine
components.description: The central trade decision brain. Receives anomaly signals, confirmation scores, wallet intelligence, and live market data. Claude cross-references all inputs and outputs a structured JSON trade decision. The prompt template provides all 10 data source readings, the tension score, any relevant wallet copytrade signals, and the list of active Polymarket geopolitical contracts with current prices.

input.anomaly_data: Full anomaly detection output including region, magnitude, FRP, confirming sources
input.financial_indicators: VIX, gold, BTC, ETH, fear/greed, currency moves
input.wallet_signals: Any active copytrade signals from WalletIntelligencePipeline
input.active_markets: List of Polymarket geopolitical contracts with current prices, volume, liquidity
input.portfolio_state: Current open positions, bankroll, unrealized PnL

interface.prompt_template: You are a geopolitical analyst and quantitative trader. You have access to 10 real-time data sources. Analyze the following anomaly and market data. Estimate the true probability of the event. Compare to the current market price. If edge > 5%, recommend a trade. Output JSON only.

components.name: PositionSizingEngine
components.description: Calculates exact position size using dynamic Kelly Criterion, scaled by anomaly severity and confirmation count. Always uses quarter-Kelly to prevent ruin. Applies liquidity cap (2% of market volume) and portfolio concentration limits.

formulas.expected_value: EV_per_dollar = (P_true * (1 - P_market) - (1 - P_true) * P_market) / P_market, which simplifies to P_true / P_market - 1. The 5% min_ev_threshold applies to this normalized per-dollar form.
formulas.kelly_fraction: f* = (p * b - q) / b, where b = (1 - P_market) / P_market, p = P_true, q = 1 - P_true

components.name: ExecutionEngine
components.description: Handles trade execution on Polymarket via py-clob-client. Supports dry-run mode (default) and live mode. Implements limit orders with slippage protection, automatic take-profit/stop-loss/time-stop exits.

security.dedicated_wallet: Never use main wallet — create a dedicated trading wallet with minimal funds
security.usdc_approval_cap: Set specific USDC approval limits via Revoke.cash, never unlimited
security.initial_capital: $50-100 for live testing, scale only after 2+ weeks of verified performance

components.name: DataRecorder
components.description: Records complete market microstructure data for valid backtesting. Logs order book depth, trade ticks, spreads, and fill behavior for every monitored market. Also records all external data source readings with timestamps. Stores pre-window and post-window data to capture timing edge. Minimum target: 1000 windows per strategy for statistical confidence.
recording_targets: Polymarket order book snapshots (bid/ask depth at 5 levels)
Polymarket trade ticks (every fill with price, size, timestamp)
Binance BTC/ETH order books (for latency/correlation analysis)
All 10 alternative data source readings with timestamps
Signal generation events with full context
Execution records (order placed, fill price, slippage, partial fills)
components.storage_format: Local JSON/Parquet files, organized by date and market
components.retention: Minimum 90 days rolling, archive to compressed Parquet monthly

state_recovery.mechanism: Maintain last_run_state.json tracking: last successful run timestamp per data source, open position details, current anomaly baselines per region, and pipeline cycle ID. On restart, detect interrupted cycles by comparing expected vs actual last_run timestamps and resume from the last complete stage.

components.name: AlertSystem
components.description: Real-time notification system via Telegram bot. Sends alerts for anomaly detections, trade signals, executed trades, exit events, and system health. Includes full context in each alert for manual override capability.

alert_types.content: Region, magnitude ratio, FRP, confirming sources, tension score
Market question, current price, estimated true prob, edge, recommended size, Claude reasoning
Contract, direction, size, fill price, slippage
Contract, exit reason (TP/SL/time), PnL, hold duration
Tracked wallet activity, strategy type, historical accuracy, position details
API failures, data gaps, pipeline latency, error counts

components.rate_limit: Max 1 alert per type per 5 minutes to prevent spam

components.name: MonitoredRegions
components.description: Configurable list of geopolitical regions monitored by the anomaly detection engine. Each region defined by a bounding box (lat/lon) and associated Polymarket market categories.

default_regions.name: Iran
default_regions.bbox_note: Western boundary (lon1: 44) intentionally captures Baghdad and eastern Iraq. Claude must contextualize signal origin — anomalies near lon 44-46 may be Iraqi rather than Iranian activity.

architecture.data_flow: 15-minute cycle: (1) DataIngestionLayer polls all 10 sources for all monitored regions -> (2) AnomalyDetectionEngine computes baselines and flags anomalies per region per source -> (3) ConfirmationScorer computes composite tension score, filters for minimum 2 confirming sources -> (4) WalletIntelligencePipeline provides any active copytrade signals from tracked wallets (daily batch, real-time monitoring overlay) -> (5) ClaudeDecisionEngine receives anomalies + scores + wallet signals + active markets, outputs structured trade decision JSON -> (6) PositionSizingEngine calculates exact USD position using dynamic quarter-Kelly scaled by magnitude and confirmations -> (7) ExecutionEngine places order on Polymarket via py-clob-client (or logs dry-run) -> (8) AlertSystem sends Telegram notification -> (9) DataRecorder logs all inputs, decisions, and executions for backtesting. Exit monitoring runs on every cycle checking open positions against TP/SL/time-stop rules.

integration_points.name: NASA FIRMS API
integration_points.latency: NRT: ~3 hours from observation; URT (Ultra Real-Time): ~60 seconds. Evaluate URT endpoints for time-critical detection.

integration_points.name: ExchangeRate API
integration_points.auth: required: free API key registration (keyless endpoint rate-limits to ~1 req/hour)
integration_points.latency: daily refresh only — no need to poll faster than hourly since underlying data updates once per day

integration_points.name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
integration_points.caveat: yfinance is an unofficial scraper with undocumented rate limits that may break without notice. Recommend Alpha Vantage free tier or CBOE data as primary VIX source, yfinance as fallback only. Note: VIX only updates during US market hours (09:30-16:00 ET).

integration_points.name: CoinGecko API
integration_points.auth: recommended: free Demo API key (public endpoint limited to 5-15 req/min; Demo key provides 30 calls/min, 10K/month). Add COINGECKO_API_KEY to env requirements.

phases.name: Core Data Pipeline & Anomaly Detection

Implement the FIRMS anomaly detection algorithm with 14-day rolling baseline and 3x threshold. Set up the DataRecorder to log all raw data. Validate against known historical events (Oct 7, Kursk, Assad fall).

OpenSkyCollector with bounding box aircraft queries

AnomalyDetectionEngine with configurable baseline window and threshold

Integrate with PositionSizingEngine for dynamic quarter-Kelly calculations. Test end-to-end signal-to-decision pipeline on historical data.
deliverables: ConfirmationScorer with configurable source weights and minimum confirmation threshold
ClaudeDecisionEngine with prompt template, input aggregation, and JSON output parsing

Dry-run mode producing detailed trade logs without execution

phases.description: Build the bulk wallet analysis system. Ingest 17K+ wallets from poly_data, classify strategies with Claude, detect insider-like patterns, and generate copytrade signals. Integrate wallet signals into the ClaudeDecisionEngine as an additional input source.
deliverables: WalletScraper ingesting from poly_data with per-wallet metrics extraction
StrategyClassifier using Claude to map wallets to 11 strategy archetypes

Exit rule monitor (take-profit +50%, stop-loss -30%, time-stop 14 days)
Telegram AlertSystem with all 6 alert types and rate limiting
Windows Task Scheduler configuration for 15-minute cycle

phases.name: Backtesting Infrastructure & Optimization
phases.description: Build statistically valid backtesting framework using recorded data. Implement fill simulation with realistic slippage modeling. Run minimum 1000-window backtests per strategy variant. Optimize anomaly thresholds, confirmation weights, and Kelly fractions based on results. Address the core lesson from source material: data completeness > strategy quality.
deliverables: Backtesting engine with realistic fill simulation (not perfect execution assumption)
Slippage model calibrated from recorded order book depth data
Pre-window and post-window data analysis for timing optimization
Parameter optimization for anomaly thresholds per region
Confirmation weight tuning based on historical signal quality
Performance report with Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate by signal type
Comparison of anomaly-only vs anomaly+wallet vs full-pipeline performance

phases.note: DataRecorder must run from Phase 1 day 1, not Phase 4 completion. The 30-day data window starts accumulating at Phase 1 start. Ensure DataRecorder is deployed and collecting data as part of Phase 1 deliverables.

tech_stack.purpose: Primary implementation language for all components
Trade decision engine, wallet strategy classification, anomaly interpretation
Whale tracking, insider detection, cross-platform arb scanning

risks.risk: Small sample size for geopolitical events
risks.mitigation: Treat system as proof-of-concept with real data, not a statistically validated strategy. Run extended dry-run periods. Do not scale capital until 50+ live signals have been evaluated. Supplement with non-geopolitical anomaly markets (weather, natural disasters) to increase signal count.

risks.risk: NASA FIRMS NRT ~3 hour data delay may reduce edge on fast-moving events; URT (~60s) mitigates but has less coverage
risks.mitigation: Evaluate URT endpoints for time-critical regions. Position as swing trading (hours-to-days) not scalping. Cross-reference with real-time sources (OpenSky aircraft, financial indicators) that update faster. Accept that the sharpest Polymarket traders may already be positioned by the time NRT data arrives.

risks.risk: Prediction market liquidity too thin for meaningful position sizes
risks.mitigation: Hard cap position size at 2% of market volume. Monitor depth before entry. Prefer markets with >$50K 24h volume. Use limit orders with tight slippage tolerance. Accept smaller positions on thin markets.

risks.risk: Claude directional accuracy degradation or API changes
risks.mitigation: Quarter-Kelly sizing absorbs 30% wrong calls. Log all Claude decisions and actual outcomes. Monitor rolling accuracy. If accuracy drops below 55%, pause live trading and re-evaluate prompt engineering. Keep prompt template versioned.

risks.risk: False positive anomaly signals (wildfires, agricultural burns, industrial activity)
risks.mitigation: Multi-source confirmation requirement (minimum 2 sources). Claude cross-references anomaly context with known seasonal patterns. Continuation bias filter suppresses signals in regions with elevated baselines. Start with conservative 3x threshold, adjust per region based on backtest.

risks.risk: Malicious dependencies or supply chain attacks on open-source tools
risks.mitigation: Audit every dependency before installation. Pin exact versions. Never use main wallet. Use dedicated trading wallet with minimal USDC. Cap approvals via Revoke.cash. Review starred-but-new repos for star-farming. Test in isolated environment before production.

risks.risk: API rate limits or service disruptions on free data sources
risks.mitigation: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff. Cache last successful response. Alert on consecutive failures. Design pipeline to degrade gracefully (reduced confirmation count but still functional). Monitor API health and prepare fallback sources.

risks.risk: Overfitting anomaly thresholds and confirmation weights to historical events
risks.mitigation: Use out-of-sample validation. Keep parameter count minimal (3x threshold is one number, not a curve-fitted model). Walk-forward optimization rather than static backtest. Track performance on events not in training set.

risks.risk: Wallet intelligence signals become stale as market structure evolves
risks.mitigation: Daily batch refresh of wallet profiles. Monitor for strategy drift (win rate changes, timing compression like BTC arb lag shrinking from 9.4s to 3.1s). Auto-flag wallets whose recent performance diverges from historical. Rotate copytrade targets monthly.

risks.risk: Regulatory or platform risk — Polymarket received CFTC approval Nov 2025 and re-entered the US market Jan 2026. Risk has shifted from access loss to compliance with CFTC derivatives regulations.
risks.mitigation: Monitor evolving CFTC compliance requirements for Polymarket. Design architecture to be platform-agnostic where possible (pmxt supports Polymarket + Kalshi + Limitless). Do not over-concentrate capital on single platform. Consult a derivatives attorney before live deployment to ensure compliance with applicable regulations.

success_criteria: Generates trade signal within 24 hours of market price moving >5 cents on a geopolitical contract, on 80%+ of such movements exceeding 10 cents
False positive rate (signals that do not result in a market move within 14 days) is below 40% for multi-source confirmed signals (confirmation_count >= 3)
Live trading achieves positive expected value over a rolling 30-trade window with at least 60% directional accuracy on anomaly-triggered trades
Position sizing prevents any single trade loss from exceeding 5% of total bankroll through quarter-Kelly and liquidity caps
Full pipeline executes in under 90-120 seconds per 15-minute cycle, including all 10 async API calls, anomaly detection, Claude decision (2-10s latency), and order placement
Data recorder achieves 99%+ uptime capturing complete order book and trade data for all monitored markets
Wallet intelligence pipeline successfully classifies 90%+ of active wallets (>10 trades) into strategy archetypes with meaningful clustering
Telegram alerts deliver within 10 seconds of signal generation with complete decision context
System runs for 30+ consecutive days in dry-run mode without data gaps, crashes, or missed cycles before live capital deployment
Backtesting framework reproduces historical signal detections (Oct 7, Kursk, Assad) with less than 2 hours timing variance from original analysis
notes: This system synthesizes approaches from 7 source analyses covering satellite anomaly trading, wallet intelligence, autonomous agent design, mathematical frameworks, open-source tooling, and backtesting methodology. Key insight from source material: the edge is not in the strategy sophistication but in data sources nobody else is monitoring (satellite thermal anomalies) combined with mathematical discipline (Kelly sizing) and automation (Claude decision engine). The 87% of wallets that lose money provide the liquidity for the 0.1% with systematic edge. Critical warning from the bot-failure source: data completeness is more important than strategy quality — the system must record everything to validate execution assumptions. Security is paramount given documented cases of malicious GitHub repos targeting Polymarket traders. Start small ($50-100), validate in dry-run, scale gradually.
